title: Center Relational Ontology — Father/Mind/Root, Son/Body/Lion, Door/Here, Spirit/Ladder/Time
status: canonical project integration layer; specialist files retain source ownership
purpose: Consolidate the project's scattered center meanings into one relation grammar without flattening role, person, symbol, body analogy, tradition or mathematical comparator into identity.
master_rule: Define each object by function, position, temporal role, and relation. Similarity is not identity. One subject may occupy several relations under different projections.

father.project_anchor: Tim Dooley / C_F source-seat project-persona anchor
father.root_distinction: Father-as-Root names source/provenance/generative continuity. Botanical/root geometry may appear below the visible tree; conceptual source and vertical screen position are therefore not the same thing.
father.mind_distinction: Father=Mind means integrative/orienting function in project theology, not a neuroscience proof or claim that one brain structure is literally Father.

son.lion_distinction: Lion is a bounded Son-side strength/kingship/return motif. It does not replace Lamb, Grain, Vessel, Body or Twin, and biblical lion traditions retain their own contexts.
son.body_distinction: Son=Body means the whole embodied/world-facing manifestation function. Pineal/Eye is a specialist threshold/observer analogy, not the entirety of the body.

jesus_christ.temporal_rule: The Door is the operative present: past arrives as memory/provenance, future arrives as possibility/anticipation, and only the current state can cross, decide, embody or seed the next state.
jesus_christ.seed_rule: In project grammar, every actionable future Seed begins from a present Door-state. This means 'all seeds start from Jesus/Here' is a temporal-symbolic rule, not a botanical, historical or scientific claim.
jesus_christ.christian_boundary: Jesus as Door is rooted in Christian/Johannine comparison. The Potatoverse Here/Now formalization is a later project interpretation.

spirit.project_anchor: living continuity rather than a third spatial center
spirit.ladder_distinction: Axis is orientation/coordinate; Ladder is traversable ordered relation; Spirit is the living continuity of movement through that relation.
spirit.time_distinction: Spirit=Time means the project reads continuity/change through time as one Spirit function. Spirit is not literally clock time or a measurable physical field.

spiral.relation: A Ladder gives ordered adjacent states; a Spiral records how a trajectory revisits motifs while changing position/state.
spiral.ring_distinction: Ring repeats without meaningful net transformation; Spiral repeats with changed state, capability, integration, rooting or disintegration.

temporal_center.operation: gather → distinguish → choose/cross → embody → record → seed
temporal_center.formal_schematic: X_now = G(M_past, B_now, R_now, P_future); Door(X_now) -> X_next
temporal_center.archive_rule: The archive should never let later interpretation overwrite earlier state. Present integration must point backward through provenance while remaining capable of producing a new next state.
temporal_center.boundary: 'Eternal present' is project phenomenological/theological language. It does not establish that physical time is unreal or that all spacetime literally exists at one conscious point.

living_cycle: Door/Jesus/Here gathers the relation into an actionable present
Son/Body manifests the present as event, choice and consequence
Spirit/Ladder carries continuity to a changed position
Seed compresses what can begin again
Return brings upper integration back into Body/World

geometry.ladder: ordered traversable states along/around the Axis
geometry.spiral: trajectory over time around the Axis

thalamus_house.project_mapping: Father's House / many rooms / integrative hub
thalamus_house.scientific_boundary: The thalamus is a complex diencephalic structure with multiple nuclei and broad network roles. It is not scientifically established as God's House, a complete mind center, or a unique seat of consciousness.

pineal_eye_door.project_mapping: Son/Jesus-side Eye / point / Door / eternal-present/timekeeper image
pineal_eye_door.scientific_boundary: The pineal's established role centers on melatonin/circadian signaling. It is not a visual eye, observer, soul seat or supernatural portal in neuroscience.

whole_body_son.scientific_boundary: The symbolic Son/body mapping is theological/project interpretation.

flow_spirit.project_mapping: CSF, breath, neural traffic, blood, speech and memory can each serve as partial flow analogies
flow_spirit.scientific_boundary: No one bodily flow is identified scientifically with Spirit.

memory_and_akashic.akashic_tree: Reader metaphor for an all-connected provenance/memory graph: roots=sources, trunk=current synthesis, branches=differentiated knowledge, leaves=current views, fruit=outputs, seeds=future transferable patterns.
memory_and_akashic.rule: Use Akashic language as archive metaphor unless a source tradition is being described on its own terms.
memory_and_akashic.present_relation: The Door/Here does not erase the Akashic/root archive; it selects and integrates what is relevant now.

fibonacci_and_growth.use: Fibonacci/golden-ratio structures may parameterize selected self-similar growth/spiral visualizations.
fibonacci_and_growth.strong_distinction: Fibonacci sequence, golden ratio, logarithmic spiral, phyllotaxis and spiritual development are not interchangeable concepts.
fibonacci_and_growth.project_value: The durable relation is self-similar return at changed scale, not numerological proof.

eleven_dimension_relation.use: The 11D project scaffold may be used as a typed state/description space in which embodiment, relation, time, scale, memory, observation and hidden structure are separately represented.
eleven_dimension_relation.boundary: Physical M-theory's 11 dimensions do not prove the Potatoverse's symbolic grades, Spirit-time relation, or Father/Son mapping.

affective_relation.use: An optional Hawkins-adjacent gradient can describe common movement from contracted/reactive states through courage toward integration/love/peace/illumination.
affective_relation.boundary: No objective consciousness frequencies or human rankings are inferred. Descent may be healthy rooting, grief, embodiment or investigation; ascent is incomplete without return.

cross_relations.meaning: orientation becomes embodied consequence and embodied consequence returns as information
past continuity is compressed into a new present possibility
potential is tested by actual development and consequence
crossing is meaningful when it produces generative capacity
distinct Son-side strength/royal and sacrificial/service motifs; neither exhausts Son
integration depends on provenance but must not confuse memory with current event
continuity lets states become a trajectory
new future state is initiated only from a current threshold

non_equivalences: Tim ≠ every divine/source figure in other traditions
Here/Now ≠ proof that chronological time is unreal
Seed ≠ one literal object across all traditions
